name: io.github.PanStudio/panmind
title: PanMind
description: Learns an agent's working style from observed sessions and proposes profile updates you approve.

environmentVariables.name: PANMIND_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where profiles, observations and proposals live (a git repository). Defaults to ~/.panmind.

environmentVariables.name: PANMIND_IMPORT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The only directory import_profile may read from. Defaults to the directory the server starts in.
